svg.title: Why each component was chosen: edge, servers, databases

g.text: Domain, CDN, web firewall, DDoS protection, bot rules
with an exception for the mobile apps
Protects every connection; MCP only over TLS
Runs the containers: load balancing, rolling deploys, TLS
99.9% availability (BRD 1477); a small team does not
One write path for the app, MCP and workflows:
checks, audit in the same transaction
Write contract (BRD 696), audit that cannot be edited or
One endpoint per tenant for customers' LLMs; OAuth
through Keycloak; rate limits per token
MCP endpoint per tenant (BRD 831), rate limits

g.data-chip: Official MCP SDK, highest support tier
g.text: Official MCP SDK, highest support tier
Sign-in, SAML or OIDC SSO per tenant, MFA, sign-in
links for external guests, OAuth 2.1 server for MCP, SCIM
Per-tenant sign-in (BRD 722), a single identity layer
(BRD 1627); sign-in data stays in our database, same
Self-hosted: no certificate of its own; covered by Metis's controls
Durable workflows: approvals that wait for days,
Business data; row-level security keeps tenants apart;
At most 15 minutes of data lost, back within 4 hours,

g.data-chip: restore to any point in 7 days
g.text: restore to any point in 7 days
Cache, pushes changes to screens, counts rate limits
Limits per token and tenant (BRD 842); changes appear

g.data-chip: holds no business data, so no backup needed
g.text: holds no business data, so no backup needed
